items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I know Lawrence Vega, he used to take music lessons the same time with me at Manuel.

ctx.x: Oh, Manuel Parade, the one who started Vega, Lawrence Vega. Yeah. That's right. I don't know who started, Brown or them other fellas, but I know Lawrence Vega, he used to take music lessons the same time with me at Manuel. He did. That's right. But I didn't know him well, but I knew he was taking lessons with Manuel. Well, I took from Monetta.
Monetta had many white pupils, my teacher. Oh yes. All through the years. Oh yes.
